items.title: Ira Gitler interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: His work with Leonard Feather on the Encyclopedia of Jazz

ctx.x: Ira Gitler is one of America’s most respected jazz historians and writers. As a native of New York City, he grew up surrounded by jazz and the influential musicians who created it. After completing his education at the University of Mississippi and Columbia University, he worked for Prestige Records and helped this label become an important home for jazz during the fifties.
